title: 你有看到巴奈嗎？
summary:
Kacaw和Panay在玩捉迷藏。Kacaw找了好多地方，每個房子裡面都有一些物品或植物，但就是沒有找到Panay，她會在哪裡呢?請小朋友跟著繪本中的男孩，一起尋找小女孩Panay吧!
透過捉迷藏的遊戲，結合數字、植物以及動物的教學設計，讓幼兒可以從繪本的互動中，學習到對數字的概念以及數數的意義。簡單又反覆的句型，可以強化學生培養族語語感。

indigenous_versions.text: Sowal sa ci Kacaw, “Panay tayra kako mikilim tisowanan yo ! cecay, tosa, tolo, sepat......... polo’!”
“qutux, sazing, cyugal, payat,... mpuw. musa’ saku’ hkangi’ isu’ lay. Bengah!” mha qu Watan.
“’aehae’, roSa’, to:o’, Sopat......... langpez, kizaw yako ’am komi:im ila ’iSo’on o!” kalih mayaka:i’.
“taha, tusha, turu, shpaat……..makthin, Puni kmilhim iaku ihun!” Tuba mzai.
“Kingal, daha, teru, sepac...., maxal. Pawan! Yahun sumu skadi di wa!”
“tasa, dusa, tau, pat,...... ima num pitu vau siva mas’an,” tupa Tahai tu, “Hanai nakilimun ku kasu.”
“ita, drusa, tjelju, sepatj,......... tapulu’, uri ku karemenanga sun lja, selep!” aya ti gecel.
“itha, drusa, tulru, supate, lrima, eneme, pitu, valru, bangate, mangeale, Pilelresane lrikatwasenganaku silape musuane!” laka kawariva kay Kalrimadraw iya kikay.
“Kingal, dha, tru, spat........ maxal, Panay mha ku miying sunan do o!” msa ka Kasaw.
semanu ti utay, “ussiq, uzusa, utulu, usepat,...... Rabetin, kilim pa iku ti timaisuan yu!”
“coni, yuso, tuyu, sʉptʉ,...... maskʉ, te ’ocu i’ima suu!” yainca to pasuya.
“sa, druwa, telu, pat,…… pulu, Pasiyall kayku mayaa kanu mam!” kema i Kulaway.
“asa, adoa, atlo, apat,...... asaka a ngernan, kalaen ko rana imo an mo Panigen!” koan ni Ngeskes.
“cacay, tusa, tulu, sepat,...... cacay a bataan, Panay a mikilim tu kaku itisuan u!” hini sa ci Kacaw.
“cani, cusa, turu, sʉpatʉ,…….. maan, Kiua tia cu ku tikirimi kasua!” misee sua Pani.
“ucani, usua, utulu, upatʉ,...... maahlʉ, Kuatʉ uakikirimicuaku ihlau!” amihla ’Uusu.

indigenous_versions.text: Milicay ci Kacaw, “Paka’araw ci Panayan kiso haw?” Sowal sa ko siri, “Awaay, deng o siri ko ma’araway ako, awaay ma’araw ci Panay.”

’aehae’, roSa’, to:o’, Sopat, haseb, SayboSi:, SayboSi: o ’aehae’, maykaSpat, hae’hae’, langpez, rini hayza’ langpez ka mae’iyaeh. ’oka’ hi kizaw.
taha, tusha, turu, shpaat, tarima, katuru, pitu, kashpat, tanathu, makthin, inai itia makthin a thau. uka Puni.
Kingal, daha, teru, sepac, rima, mmteru, mpitu, mmsepac, mngari, maxal. Maxal kana ka seediq ni hini. Uka ka Lubi.
tasa, dusa, tau, pat, ima, num, pitu, vau, siva, mas’an, aiza isaincin bununtu mamas’an. uka Hanai.
ita, drusa, tjelu, sepatj, lima, unem, pitju, alu, siva, tapulu’, izua a mantapulu’ a cawcau i maza. neka ti selep.
itha, drusa, tulru, supate, lrima, eneme, pitu, valru, bangate, mangeale, tamangeale ku umaumase kikay. kadrua ku Pilelresane.
Kingal, dha, tru, spat, rima, mataru, empitu, maspat, mngari, maxal, niqan maxal seejiq ka hini. Ungat ka Panay.
ussiq, uzusa, utulu, usepat, ulima, unem, upitu, uwalu, usiwa, Rabetin, yau Rabetin lazat tazian. mai ti imuy.
coni, yuso, tuyu, sʉptʉ, eimo, nomʉ, pitu, voyu, sio, maskʉ, mo maskʉ ’e cou tan’e. uk’a ci paicʉ.
misasa, miyadruwa, miyatelu, miyapat, miyalluwatr, miyanem, miyapitu, miyawalu, miyaiwa, muketrep. ullaya a muketrep a trau kadrini. uniyan i Pasiyall.
amian so asaka a ngernan o tao do jia. asa, adoa, atlo, apat, lima, anem, pito, wao, siam, asa, a ngernan abo si Paningen.
cacay, tusa, tulu, sepat, lima, enem, pitu, walu, siwa, cacay a bataan, cacay a bataan ku tademaw itini. nai’ ci Panay.
cani, cusa, turu, sʉpatʉ, rima, nʉmʉ, pitu, aru, sia, maan, ’una nesi mamaan cau. ’akia Kiua.
cacihli’, sasua, tatulu, aupatʉ, lalima, aʉnʉmʉ, aupitu, lalalu, sasia, umaramahlʉ, maru umaramahlʉ cucu’u naani. uka’a Kuatʉ.

indigenous_versions.text: Paka’araw ci Panayan kiso haw?
wal su’ ktan qu Bengah ga?
So’o hayza’ ay Sahoero: hi kizaw?
minriqaz ihu Puni qa?
Qntaan su ka Lubi?
adu sinadu kasu mas Hanai cia?
napacun sun tjai selep?
laka wadreelesu ki Pilelresane?
Qmnita su Panay hug?
temayta isu ti imuyan ni?
osko aiti ’o paicʉ？
menau yu kane Pasiyall?
mo ni masta si Paningen?
makaazih kisu ci Panayan haw?
cinimʉ’ʉra kara kasu Kiua?
hlikumitau i Kuatʉ?
